title: NEW PARTNERSHIPS! | COPICafe Episode 45 | Cornucopias
description:
In this episode of COPI Cafe, Josh shares some important details on employee tokens at Cornucopias. Then, Josh goes on to share some information on strategy and the potential new partnerships that could be formed from this. Rob and Josh then go on to talk about the acceptance criteria for Solace. Rob then addresses a few questions from the community on discord. Finally, the guys get on to an exciting new leak! 

00:00 Beverage Choices
03:30 Employee Tokens
04:58 Partnerships
07:50 Solace Acceptance Criteria
13:41 Community Questions
19:11 Leaks!
